title: cone
body:
## cone

Creates a polygonal cone surface of given height and base radius. Its centre is the midpoint of the axis, the axis follows direction, and the apex lies on the direction side; resolution sets the number of facets around the axis and capping closes the base. Use it as a marker, glyph or simple test geometry; coordinates are in the units of the data it is shown with.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- centre is not the centre of the base: the base lies height/2 behind it and the apex height/2 ahead along direction.

Native constructor: `Cone`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `centre` | This property specifies the center of the cone. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `direction` | An axis token, a vector, or an azimuth and elevation about an up axis | `{"type":"union","title":"direction","summary":"An axis token, a vector, or an azimuth and elevation about an up axis","options":[{"type":"string","title":"axis token such as 'x+' or 'z-'"},{"type":"array","title":"vector [x, y, z]","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3},{"type":"object","title":"direction object","properties":{"axis":{"type":"string","summary":"Axis token such as 'x+'"},"azimuth":{"type":"number","minimum":-360,"maximum":360,"summary":"Degrees about the up axis from the reference axis"},"elevation":{"type":"number","minimum":-180,"maximum":180,"summary":"Degrees tilted from the plane perpendicular to up"},"vector":{"type":"array","title":"vector [x, y, z]","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3},"up":{"type":"union","title":"up direction","options":[{"type":"string","title":"axis token such as 'z+'"},{"type":"array","title":"vector [x, y, z]","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}]}}}]}` | `[1,0,0]` | `[1,0,0]` |
| `height` | This property specifies the height of the cone. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true}` | `2` | `2` |
| `radius` | This property specifies the radius of the base of the cone. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true}` | `1` | `1` |
| `resolution` | This property indicates the number of divisions around the cone. The higher this number, the closer the polygonal approximation will come to representing a cone, and the more polygons it will contain. Schemaxis accepts at most 512 facets: the bundled VTK clamps larger values to 512 (VTK_CELL_SIZE) without a warning, so a larger request would not be honoured. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":3,"maximum":512}` | `32` | `32` |
| `capping` | If this property is set to 1, the base of the cone will be capped with a filled polygon. Otherwise, the base of the cone will be open. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "cone"
}
```
